Overview

Comayagua is a city in CM with a population of 150,000. Honduras’s former capital, a historic colonial city with a famous cathedral clock and well-preserved architecture. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 25.0.
